topStellarWallet.title: Top 2 Stellar Wallet
topStellarWallet.intro: No public record names GC4HM4YR653H5F7R3S2AS6E2VIRLIQTOJ7UQCDUVJD65Z2M42UFHFWSA. It is not a bridge vault, not an issuer signer, and not a directory entry. The activity says it is an operator wallet inside the large-holder cluster. What the chain shows:
points: Opened 6 Jan 2025 by GAXDY2FIEQMIMVBG6SFIJJGQQAYINFNCP4WBKG6VHOOOU2RXJ74WIRX7, which sets home_domain stellarterm.com. That domain’s file does not list the funder, so it is not StellarTerm’s wallet. The same day the funder emptied itself into this account: 85,330,781.80 TFT. That funder had pooled the TFT on 1–2 Jul 2024 from ten other holders. Memos were Test / Transfer. None of it came from the issuer.
On 11 Jan 2025, four more holders sent a round 90,000,000 TFT with no memos. Two of them are current ranks 7 and 9. The other two were created the same morning in 2021 as ranks 4, 6, 8, and 9.

It spends like an ops desk. Memos include Fund ops mainnet st wallet, Ops wallet, Mik compensation testing, Compensation May minting pay, Weynand demo tokens, and Testing. Those are labels this wallet wrote on outgoing payments. They are not a published name.

The strongest link: it paid the published TFChain bridge vault 7,041,104 TFT. Memos were twin_15520 (41,002 TFT) and twin_15992 (7,000,102 TFT). That 7,000,102 matches the executed bridge mints already counted for TFChain twin 15992, the rank-3 holder.
topStellarWallet.close: One signer. No trades, no offers. Inflows minus these payments equal the live 166,938,487.45 TFT. A person’s or company’s name is not on the account. The behavior is a consolidation wallet that later bridges to specific twins and pays “ops”, “compensation”, and “demo” from the same key.

portal.title: SPORE token at $0.01
portal.summary: $0.01 is a fixed sale price on the page, paid in TFT, at 10 SPORE per TFT, through 30 September 2026 (or next extension). Purchases are final. SPORE cannot be sold through the protocol until a Dutch auction after October 1, 2026.
quotes: Fixed at $0.01 until 30 September 2026 (or next extension).
Cost is fixed at 10 SPORE per TFT by agreement.
SPORE purchases are final once completed.
SPORE cannot be sold through the protocol until October 1, 2026.
After September 2026, SPORE price will float based on market conditions via Dutch auction.
portal.source: migrate.projectmycelium.com token-economics page and FAQ, bundle last modified 21 September 2026, read 28 September 2026.
portal.aside: The portal describes a purchase. It does not say the protocol will hand back cash at one cent. Pricing the current TFT supply at $0.10 per token (1:10 SPORE) would require $97,919,817.40, therefore the $0.01 price per SPORE is not possible and needs further explanations from the team.

rows.title: graphql.grid.tf has no balances
rows.body: https://graphql.grid.tf/graphql indexes twins, farms, nodes, and contracts. It does not hold TFT balances or transfers. Mint, burn, and refund types returned 0 rows while TFChain storage held thousands of executed bridge records. That is a missing processor, not a lag behind the chain head.

rows.title: TFChain System.Account
rows.body: https://tfchain.grid.tf (Tfchain Mainnet, tokenDecimals 7). Live balances are System.Account data.free and data.reserved. Balances.Account is the wrong map and returns zero even for a funded account. At block 24,976,282, 54,431 accounts summed to 242,630,409.03 TFT, matching Balances.TotalIssuance.
